title: O Próximo Passo
summary: Thursday 2027-02-04. The executives set preliminary priorities for expansion: Street Fighter 6 (one competitor) and Rocket League (three players and a coach) are the 2027 priorities for research, F1 and EA Sports FC stay in medium-term planning, nothing authorised. Adrian also starts a discreet search for a flexible sixth Counter-Strike player. League scrims: Main beat Winthrop University 2-0; Academy White beat Academy Blue 2-1. The organisation watches the first IEM Dallas matches at the Commons.
keyEvents: 8:14 — Executive meeting (Ethan Calder, Claire Whitcomb, Sofia Alvarez, Marcus, Emily): Street Fighter 6 with a single player and technical support; Rocket League with three players and one coach; F1 and EA Sports FC with individual representatives later; no hiring and no debut date.

9:06 — Sixth-player problem: a versatile player able to rifle, support roles and eventually AWP; not a replacement for Owen; no public announcement; Marcus and Luk may study free-agent profiles and CCT substitution rules.
9:48–11:56 — Main vs Winthrop University (Wilson, Kisno, Bradley, Cody Sun, Mixtsure), private MD3: Kairos win 2-0 (31 min; second game after being 5k gold behind).

10:17–15:48 — Academy Blue vs Academy White, private MD3: White win game 1 (34 min) and game 3, Blue win game 2 (28 min); Academy White 2-1 Academy Blue. Hai and Sable warn against reading it as a promotion.
12:38 — The Commons watches IEM Dallas 2027, in progress since 2027-02-03: Group C M80 vs Astralis, Astralis win 2-1 (Train to Astralis, Nuke to M80, Cobblestone 13-11 Astralis).
17:22 — Group A: FURIA beat Team Liquid 2-0 (Inferno 13-9, Overpass 13-10).
18:36 — Owen, in hospital, is told by Caleb that Adrian and Luk are checking rules for an emergency option; no one is hired and he remains the AWPer.

20:11–22:27 — Commons evening: Rocket League and Street Fighter on the shared consoles; Sofia proposes an internal tournament to present those games; Marcus has found only imperfect free-agent profiles and awaits the CCT's reply.
consequences: Street Fighter 6 and Rocket League enter a research and scouting phase; no contract, date or division exists.
A discreet search for a sixth Counter-Strike player begins.
canonIntroduced: Expansion priorities for 2027: Street Fighter 6 and Rocket League (research only); F1 and EA Sports FC later.
IEM Dallas group results of 2027-02-04 (see data/competitive-world-overrides).
continuityNotes: The episode says the IEM Dallas groups are A (Vitality, FURIA, Liquid, MIBR) and C (M80, Astralis, paiN, BC.Game); they match the draw already in the overlay.
Only the results narrated are registered; the other round-1 matches of groups A and C are not narrated.
realWorldReferences: Street Fighter 6, Rocket League, F1 and EA Sports FC are real-world games; IEM Dallas teams and players are real-world references with fictional-canon results.
confirmedFacts: IEM Dallas started on 2027-02-03 and has four groups with two advancing; Kairos Gaming does not take part.
Astralis beat M80 2-1 in Group C; FURIA beat Team Liquid 2-0 in Group A.
Main beat Winthrop University 2-0 in a private scrim; White beat Blue 2-1 in a private scrim.
unconfirmedDetails: Any hiring, budget or date for the new modalities and the identity of any sixth-player candidate.
notes: Kairos Gaming is the public name of the Counter-Strike Main team.
